junro.title: Budget Curve — the comparative-empirical claim measured: pairs + tally vs absolute sizing at equal budget (R13's claim, acceptance-brief §5's priced option — the purpose sentence graduated from ruled language to measurement), the acceptance harness's second arm
inputs: the collaborator's ruling at the prioritree-cli close (2026-11-21: 'proceed' — suisen's primary recommendation executed; the recommendation at .plans/ideation/2026-11-20-prioritree-cli/recommend/next-effort.md)

acceptance-brief §5's priced mechanism (the in-harness baseline: each item sized by the same noisy comparator at the same p, the sizings repeated to equal budget — n0 judgments total — the sizes sorted into the sizer's own ranking, tau computed identically, the two taus compared per cell; the earning condition: seeds fixed, runs deterministic, the per-cell comparison recorded as data)
the k=1 baseline table (the opening evidence: 8 of 27 in-band cells sub-floor at single judgment, min tau 0.4714 — recorded at the core store's synthesize/acceptance-bytes.md)
the acceptance harness whole (src/prioritree/acceptance.py — the matrix, the seeds, the k=3 quorum, the tau-b integer measure, the RNG discipline: the curve's substrate)
CONTINUATION.md's staged pointer at the CLI close (the ruled candidates: the budget curve — the earned-later menu's first cousin — or the FastAPI service; the MCP tier banked beyond both)

structure.purpose: THE PER-UNIT PIPELINE: the unit's discover → understand → synthesize before its build — discover/understand ride ungated packets (tansa's census, rikai's mechanisms); the synthesis the gated increment (togo, closing G-BUDGET-CURVE-BRIEF at the collaborator's approval). THE PRECEDENCE: no build dispatch fires until the brief gate is green.
structure.entry_condition: the collaborator's validation of this composition stands (the seven questions ruled, 2026-11-21); no build dispatch fires until the brief gate is green (the precedence law)

structure.purpose: THE CURVE'S BUILD: ONE unit — the sizer arm at equal budget in the ruled binary-threshold form, the paired comparison at both budget points (k=1 and k=3), the record at the store's build home, the ONE additive acceptance.py amendment (the quorum threading) named in the brief and priced at the gate — one-commit-per-increment through the tree's own git instrument.
structure.entry_condition: the unit's brief gate green — the exact-task law; the build fires only after G-BUDGET-CURVE-BRIEF

steps.tool: make dev && make test && make lint && make typecheck at the prioritree root

structure.purpose: THE BOOKEND — CONTINUATION.md's budget-curve entry (the sizer-model ruling named, the measured curve at both budget points, the claim's graduation stated honestly at the collaborator's ruling), the next candidates staged (the FastAPI service — the stack's next layer), the done call at the collaborator's ruling.
structure.entry_condition: G-BUDGET-CURVE closed green on the route and the collaborator has called the close

conditions: the budget_curve module lands per its approved brief — the exact-task law; the ONE additive acceptance.py amendment (accept_run's quorum: int = ACCEPTANCE_QUORUM parameter, the default pinned) lands with the acceptance suite re-run green and the default behavior byte-identical — the amendment recorded on the route, the landed unit never silently re-opened

the sizer arm green in the ruled model: the binary-threshold form at the same p (the deterministic round-robin schedule over the n-1 integer thresholds, one flip draw per judgment at rate p), the equal-budget law EXACT (the sizer's judgment count = n0 x quorum per run, asserted), the exact-Fraction scores (no floats in the ranking), the pairing law (both arms' latent orders identical per seed, asserted), the perfect case (p=0, n=10, seed 1109, k=3: tau = 1 exactly)

the determinism green: the same (n, p, seed, quorum) => byte-identical sizer record across replays (the clock-free surface); the measure invariants hold on the sizer's own groups (P+Q+T = n0) — accept_measure REUSED, never re-implemented

the curve's record landed at the store's build home (build/budget-curve-record.md, the acceptance-verification precedent): the per-cell table whole (both arms' taus, both budget points k=1 and k=3, the 9 cells x 3 seeds), the comparison as data, the reading stated honestly — the ordering claim asserted NOWHERE the data has not ruled it

pyright 0 errors 0 warnings and ruff zero findings on the landed code — zero convenience ignores (the S311-class per-file named ruling extends to budget_curve.py, priced at the brief); zero new runtime deps (random stdlib, already named); kensho's independent re-run green — the read-back the evidence, not the build's word

CONTINUATION.md carries the budget-curve entry — the sizer model named, the measured curve (both budget points), the claim's graduation stated honestly at the collaborator's ruling (supported => the README's claim gains the measured citation; falsified => the record states it and the claim's language re-ruled — never silent, never pre-written)
the next candidates staged (the FastAPI service — the stack's next layer, the deps/concurrency/store questions arriving intact; the MCP tier banked beyond), the ruling left to the collaborator
the collaborator rules the close — the done call recorded same-turn through the junro and the route's status set done at the ruling

THE BUILD BRIEF for the unit budget-curve LANDED and APPROVED: togo's synthesis over the unit's discovery census (discover/budget-curve) + mechanism analysis (understand/budget-curve) — the brief carrying the banked shapes, the scope fence, and the return forms — the dispatches cite this brief
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the brief judged ready-to-build; the unit's dispatches fire only after

amendments.what: add-question {"question": "Q-curve-sizer", "text": "THE LOAD-BEARING ONE — the sizer arm's mechanism: what IS a \"size,\" and what is the noise on it? [PROPOSED: the binary-threshold form at the same p — every sizing judgment a binary answer at the same wrong-information rate (\"is item i's latent position above threshold j?\", j an integer in {1..n-1}, the scale's own midpoints, zero floats); the true answer deterministic from the truth; ONE draw per judgment, u < p => the FLIPPED answer (the same flip idiom, the same rate, the same grammar as the pairwise comparator); the threshold schedule deterministic round-robin (judgment m uses threshold ((m-1) mod (n-1)) + 1 — the exhaustive-coverage analog); the score the exact Fraction (yes-count / B_i); the ranking score-descending groups measured by accept_measure REUSED; the per-item budget B_i the even split of n0 x quorum with the deterministic remainder (the first r items in id order get the ceiling, r = n/2 at every ruled n); the pairing law: both arms run from random.Random(seed) fresh instances at the SAME seed => the latent permutation byte-identical across arms => the comparison PAIRED per cell. REASON: per-judgment information matched BY CONSTRUCTION — the only structural difference is the aggregation (pairwise + tally vs absolute score + sort), exactly the claim's subject; zero free parameters. The continuous-scale form REJECTED (the noise-family free parameter rigs the verdict); the reference forms REJECTED (the strawman / the drift model).]"}
